findings.note: ESPN's game page has Detroit at 7-10-3 and Boston at 13-5-1, lists Dylan Larkin on non-roster IR until about Dec 20 and Simon Edvinsson until about Nov 28, and shows Boston ahead in goals for and goals against per game.
Rotowire (Nov 17, via MLive) says Daniil Tarasov (.931 save percentage, 1.84 goals-against average) will start for Detroit, with Boston on the second night of a back-to-back. CBS lists DET -117.
ESPN's Nov 18 preview lists the line at DET -122, total 6.5, so Detroit is favored even though it trails Boston in goals per game (2.62 to 3.55) and goals allowed per game (2.95 to 2.60).

A Rotowire item dated Nov. 17 says Daniil Tarasov (1.84 GAA, .931 save percentage, two shutouts) will start for Detroit after shutting out Tampa Bay. Boston is on the second night of a back-to-back, and this page lists the total at 6.
ESPN's Nov. 18 preview lists the total at 6.5, so Under 6 at Caesars may be the worse number, with a push at exactly 6. The preview also says Boston averages 3.55 goals per game.

Detroit is without Dylan Larkin (IR) and Simon Edvinsson, and Boston is missing James Hagens. ESPN also shows Detroit's penalty kill at 70.5% and John Gibson's save percentage at .862, which could help the Over.
